audit_scope: Concept-only Cuba 1970–1990 effect/API inventory; no runtime edits.

catalogue.policy: Basic/cash crop allocation as diversification proxy
catalogue.consumer: AGRI_update_math_variables; weekly_harvest_billion enters Imperia weekly income
catalogue.units: allocation 0..1; weekly income conversion 0.00019 × yearly harvest value
catalogue.cap: each crop allocation is clamped from 0 to 1
catalogue.custom_glue: Sugar identity, ration deliveries, or exact trade flow require new variables/readers.

catalogue.status: native tier changes supported; new outcomes require care
catalogue.consumer: existing health/education budget ideas; EDU_update_education_idea_DYNMOD and annual literacy pulse
catalogue.units: tier transition; literacy_rate is bounded 0.01..1 and changes through annual simulation
catalogue.cap: tier maximum; helper fallback may grant political power rather than more service
catalogue.custom_glue: Confirm CUB literacy initialization and exact current cost formula before using health/education cost multipliers.

catalogue.policy: US normalization and Soviet trade dependence
catalogue.status: relation effects native; bilateral commodity accounting absent
catalogue.consumer: bilateral relations and international market income calculation
catalogue.scope: bilateral relation for agreement/opinion; country-wide for market income modifier
catalogue.units: relation effects are not commodity volume; verify modifier conversion at consumer
catalogue.custom_glue: Soviet fuel/arms/credit dependence and embargo relief as tracked amounts need bilateral counters/readers.

catalogue.policy: Public services, scarcity, and limited private-sector activity
catalogue.status: native output/tax modifiers; ownership/council institution absent
catalogue.provider: native MD and Imperia modifier/economy systems
catalogue.units: modifier-specific; money expenses must be weekly if recurring
catalogue.custom_glue: Private/cooperative ownership ratios and worker councils need custom institution variables and reconciler.

catalogue.provider: native law, intelligence, population and resistance readers
catalogue.units: law/intelligence modifier-specific; monthly_population is population change
catalogue.custom_glue: Use explicit counters/effects for politically attributed exile, return and amnesty.

catalogue.status: combat and intelligence APIs native; expeditionary distinction absent

catalogue.custom_glue: Mission commitments, overseas manpower and related recurring expenses require project-specific variables/effects.

catalogue.status: event/transaction APIs available; Cuba agreement absent
catalogue.scope: payer and recipient must be explicit

research_and_reward_api.research_syntax: add_tech_bonus = { name = id category = verified_category uses = N bonus = 0.25 }
research_and_reward_api.doctrine_syntax: add_doctrine_cost_reduction = { name = id category = land_doctrine cost_reduction = 0.50 uses = N }

research_and_reward_api.initialization_caveat: CUB 1970 history applies mdcw_apply_1970_infantry_research; confirm research is still available before granting a research use.

recurring_cost_contract.conversion: derive from actual source period and reader; do not guess
recurring_cost_contract.separate: one-time focus deduction, timed idea, and tick-maintained expense

custom_glue_required: Cuba programme refresh and exact-party dynamic modifiers
confidence_boundary: Static source audit only. Engine loading, scopes, numerical balance, previews and multiplayer behavior need later validation.

final_scope_correction.equipment_market: Equipment sales income; unused in final Cuban focus/starting effects.

resource_exports.calculation: Actual exported native resource units × market price × (1 + global and resource-specific modifiers) × yearly-to-weekly conversion. Zero actual exports yield zero revenue.

final_scope_correction.sugar: agriculture_district_income_tax_modifier is the verified modeled fiscal proxy, not literal sugar tons or a sugar-price system.
final_scope_correction.setup: edu_02/health_02/corruption_level_04 are proposed missing-category 1970 baselines; CUB1970 history does not currently supply them.
